name: ClickUp MCP
description: Lets agents manage ClickUp tasks, docs, comments, and time entries over a hosted OAuth MCP server in public beta, with no deletion tools.

skills.name: Task Workflows
skills.description: Manages tasks with assignees, priorities, and due dates across ClickUp lists and spaces from natural-language prompts.

skills.name: Executive Reports
skills.description: Creates release notes, status updates, and portfolio summaries from the tasks and docs in a ClickUp Workspace.

skills.name: Time Tracking
skills.description: Logs time entries and manages timers in a ClickUp Workspace through the hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Workspace Search
skills.description: Searches tasks, docs, and comments to answer work questions, and summarizes comment threads into action items.
